reconciliation: The usable Turbospectrum molecular .bsyn lists live in the iSpec TOOL dir input/linelists/turbospectrum/molecules/ (RYA-236 audit), NOT the raw-download dir data/linelists/molecular/exomol/ (.bz2) the RYA-237 recon looked in. Vendored here as the git-tracked secure record of truth.
pipeline_resolution: Turbospectrum (iSpec, use_molecules=True) reads from the iSpec molecules dir; repointing that hard-coded path mid-stream is risky, so the vendored copy is the TRACKED BACKUP-OF-RECORD. The RYA-355 [molecular] guard asserts the vendored copy is present + non-empty + provenance-complete (the CI gate), and — when iSpec is present — that the iSpec dir still matches it (drift = a reinstall wiped/reset a list).

CO.source: CO ExoMol line list, Li et al. 2015 (ApJS 216, 15)
CO.distribution: RYA-236 conversion of the ExoMol Li2015 CO list to the Turbospectrum babsma .dat format (converted to species code 0608.012016; conversion script external to this repo — RYA-236)

midir_reach.note: CO_IR_Li2015 is the genuine mid-IR rovibrational list (spans NIR overtones through the fundamental).

conversion.citation: Li, Gordon, Rothman et al. 2015, ApJS 216, 15 (CO rovibrational line lists), ExoMol-hosted Li2015
conversion.recipe: vacuum λ = 1e8/(E_u−E_l); χ_low = E_l/8065.543937 eV; loggf = log10(1.49919e-16·λ²·g_u·A_ul); filter ν ≥ 1000 cm⁻¹ (drops 7713 pure-rotational lines below 1000 cm⁻¹ / above 10 µm)
conversion.roundtrip: PASS — reproduces the vendored CO_IR_Li2015.dat: 117783/117783 lines, 0 only-in-either; max dev λ 8.7e-3 Å, χ 5.1e-6 eV, loggf 5.0e-4 dex, A exact at the file's 3-sig-fig precision. Closes the RYA-360 CO-script reproducibility gap.

OH_MYTHOS_midIR.source: OH X–X ro-vibrational — Mitev, Bowesman, Zhang, Yurchenko & Tennyson 2025, MNRAS 536, 3401 (ExoMol LXI; OH MYTHOS)
OH_MYTHOS_midIR.distribution: ExoMol MYTHOS v20240526 (https://www.exomol.com/db/OH/16O-1H/MYTHOS/); DOI 10.1093/mnras/stae2803; converted via scripts/molecular_linelist_convert.py

conversion.recipe: ground X–X (ro-vibrational), ν ≥ 1000 cm⁻¹; vacuum λ; loggf = log10(1.49919e-16·λ²·g_u·A); χ_low = E_l/8065.543937 eV

midir_window.label: OH 1-0 fundamental (2600-3600 cm⁻¹)
midir_window.verdict: MID-IR PRESENT (acquired; was 0 in the held electronic .bsyn)
